sourceFiles.role: Three independently authored expanded capsule batches and category merge helper. The file states that this library is MIT and is not derived from the GPL Danbooru CSV.
Curated base taxonomy merged with all three expanded batches into CAPSULE_TAXONOMY.
Upstream generator that evaluates both TypeScript sources and serializes the complete merged taxonomy.
Generated source taxonomy flattened into the PC asset.

asset.format: flat JSON list of PromptCapsule records
asset.negativeRule: true when category is 反向提示词; this matches the upstream mobile CapsuleCategory.isNegative rule
asset.promptTextRule: The runtime getter replaces underscores in en with spaces; the stored en value remains the canonical tag.
